scope: Source receipts, immutable bridge semantics, a signed synthetic seven-receipt preexecution composition fixture, fail-closed consumer plan validation, negative controls and evidence DAG only.

authority_resolution.owner_overlay: ODR-45 upgrades the effective bridge status to CONFIRMED_MECHANICAL_DYNAMICS_BRIDGE without modifying the frozen bridge file.

consumer_rule.application: Each channel shall carry exactly one physical-to-dynamics bridge application in its complete lineage. Frame, wrench and collision apply at the consumer boundary; mass and inertia bind the already-bridged ledger and shall not numerically reapply the bridge.

induced_operators.mass: mass invariant plus CG re-expression frozen in the bridged ledger
induced_operators.inertia: R I R^T plus parallel-axis terms frozen in the bridged ledger
induced_operators.wrench: dual adjoint with explicitly declared application point
induced_operators.collision_geometry: rigid transform of every collision geometry frame

forbidden: M_DYNAMICS_NONPHYSICAL as a physical load path
unbridged V3_R2 mass/inertia with bridged dynamics
legacy V2 URDF-only receipt as sufficient binding

nonclaims: Does not repeat or replace the current-system intake package.
Does not repeat or replace evidence admission or preexecution authorization/security.
Does not repeat the MPI producer bridge derivation or producer Gate.
Does not instantiate a system interface or URDF.
Does not close NC18, NC19, contact, grasp, production or release.
Does not run dynamics, contact, grasp, CAD or the Unified-R2 generator.
